# Komodo Consulting

> Komodo Consulting is a premium IT outsourcing and consulting partner based in Portugal, helping European companies scale their technology teams through staff augmentation, dedicated development teams, and nearshore delivery.

Komodo Consulting operates within EU timezone, culture, and legal framework, providing access to top-tier engineering talent in Portugal.

## Services

- [IT Outsourcing](https://komodo-consulting.pt/services): Flexible outsourcing models for companies that need technical capability without the overhead of full-time hiring.
- [Staff Augmentation](https://komodo-consulting.pt/services): Embed pre-vetted engineers directly into your existing team and workflows.
- [Dedicated Teams](https://komodo-consulting.pt/services): End-to-end development teams that integrate and perform from day one.
- [Nearshore Portugal](https://komodo-consulting.pt/services/nearshore-portugal): Access top-tier engineering talent in Portugal, within EU timezone, culture, and legal framework.

## Industries

- [Fintech](https://komodo-consulting.pt/industries/fintech): Technology teams for financial services, payments, and banking products.
- [Healthcare](https://komodo-consulting.pt/industries/healthcare): Engineering support for digital health platforms and medical software.
- [SaaS](https://komodo-consulting.pt/industries/saas): Scalable development capacity for SaaS companies at any growth stage.
